title: Spare tire, run-flat tires, and trunk space
summary: Feedback centers on whether the vehicle includes a spare tire or run-flat tires, with some owners valuing flat-tire mobility while others dislike missing spares or cargo-space compromises.

positive.summary: Positive comments praise run-flat capability or the inclusion of a spare tire for reassurance after a flat.

negative.summary: Negative comments focus on anxiety about not having a spare tire and on a spare tire placement that reduces trunk usability.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined comments mostly mention the presence, absence, or uncertainty around spare tires, run-flat tires, or inflator kits without clear overall sentiment.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined, so the evidence for clear sentiment is limited.
One positive example appears off-topic to tires or spares, which limits confidence in summarizing positive sentiment from the sample.
The topic includes related but distinct subtopics such as spare-tire availability, run-flat tires, inflator kits, and trunk-space impact.
